databaseDataSourceConfig.sqlQuery:
SELECT '已分配' AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM outbound_orders WHERE create_time BETWEEN {{st}} AND {{et}}
        AND ({{brand}} = 'all' OR brand = {{brand}})
        AND ({{sc}} = 'all' OR {{sc}} IS NULL OR {{sc}} = '' OR sales_channel = {{sc}}) and allocation_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT '已拣货', COUNT(*) FROM outbound_orders WHERE create_time BETWEEN {{st}} AND {{et}}
        AND ({{brand}} = 'all' OR brand = {{brand}})
        AND ({{sc}} = 'all' OR {{sc}} IS NULL OR {{sc}} = '' OR sales_channel = {{sc}}) and picking_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT '已复核', COUNT(*) FROM outbound_orders WHERE create_time BETWEEN {{st}} AND {{et}}
        AND ({{brand}} = 'all' OR brand = {{brand}})
        AND ({{sc}} = 'all' OR {{sc}} IS NULL OR {{sc}} = '' OR sales_channel = {{sc}}) and review_time IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT '已出库', COUNT(*) FROM outbound_orders WHERE create_time BETWEEN {{st}} AND {{et}}
        AND ({{brand}} = 'all' OR brand = {{brand}})
        AND ({{sc}} = 'all' OR {{sc}} IS NULL OR {{sc}} = '' OR sales_channel = {{sc}}) and outbound_time IS NOT NULL

WITH today_stats AS (
    SELECT
        -- 待收货数量（总数量 - 已收货数量，确保不为负）
        COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(0, applied_return_qty - received_qty)), 0) AS unreceived_qty,
        
        -- 已收货数量
        COALESCE(SUM(received_qty), 0) AS received_qty,
        
        -- 总数量
        COALESCE(SUM(applied_return_qty), 0) AS total_qty
    FROM customer_return_in_transit
    WHERE create_time BETWEEN {{st}} AND {{et}}
        AND ({{brand}} = 'all' OR brand = {{brand}})
),
today_shelved AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(shelved_qty), 0) AS shelved_qty
    FROM customer_return_in_transit
    WHERE create_time BETWEEN {{st}} AND {{et}}
        AND ({{brand}} = 'all' OR brand = {{brand}})
)
SELECT
    unreceived_qty AS "pending-receipt-qty",
    received_qty AS "received-qty",
    shelved_qty AS "shelved-qty",
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT total_qty FROM today_stats) > 0 
        THEN ROUND((shelved_qty::DECIMAL / (SELECT total_qty FROM today_stats) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS "shelving-completion-rate"
FROM today_stats, today_shelved
